summary: BEDRIFTSPROFIL AS (org. no. 979 122 438) is a private limited company (AS) based in Skaun, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-08-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.490 (Engroshandel med andre husholdningsvarer). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 6.4 m and net income was NOK 480 185. CEO: Kim Dromnes; board chair: Kim Dromnes. Also: LEI 549300JA5D1WFXEDUX47.
